sources.author: Clinical Trials Transformation Initiative (CTTI)
sources.title: AACT pipe-delimited flat-file export of ClinicalTrials.gov, data dated 2026-11-17 (file 20261118_export_ctgov.zip)
supports: Input snapshot for every trial record in this dataset. The downloaded zip has SHA-256 6f80d7298d5e3398852b82b60a31e15a03e138cbd2e564e161740318aa7e3822; downloads require a free AACT account.

Study status, design, posted-results dates, conditions, interventions, facility locations, baseline result groups and baseline measurements were read from the studies, conditions, interventions, brief_summaries, facilities, countries, result_groups, baseline_counts and baseline_measurements tables.

sources.author: Clinical Trials Transformation Initiative (CTTI)
sources.title: AACT: The entire ClinicalTrials.gov registry, in one analyzable database
supports: AACT is a public relational database of ClinicalTrials.gov protocol and results data, refreshed daily, with downloadable full snapshots for registered users.
